title: Capped Increment
goal: Increment a byte counter without panicking when it reaches maximum capacity.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1: Types and Values

hints: Which overflow method clamps at the maximum type limit instead of wrapping?
Check the expected parameter type of `u8` method calls.
explanation: `saturating_add` caps the sum at `u8::MAX` (255) when adding `250` and `10`, preventing arithmetic overflow. `wrapping_add` wraps around to `4`, failing the boundary test. `checked_add` returns an `Option<u8>`, causing compiler error `E0308` because the function expects a plain `u8` return type.
